:::{#exm-model-kl-poisson}
#### Divergence between two Poisson rates

For one observation $\Rvar \sim \Pois(\rate_0)$,
$\log \p(x \mid \rate) = x \log \rate - \rate - \log x!$, so

$$
\ba
\kldivf{\rate_0}{\rate}
&= \Expp_{\rate_0}\sb{\Rvar \log \frac{\rate_0}{\rate} - \rate_0 + \rate}\\
&= \rate_0 \log \frac{\rate_0}{\rate} - \rate_0 + \rate.
\ea
$$

:::
